result.evidence: The lesson suffers from a systemic rendering failure starting in Part 3 and continuing through the end. Dozens of formulas and variables are shown as raw LaTeX code (e.g., `\lambda \approx \dfrac{1.00\text{ nm}}{...}` at 09:15, `\tan \theta` at 15:56, `\psi` at 18:26). This occurs in almost every text box, question, and sidebar in the later halves of the lesson, making the content significantly harder to read. Additionally, there is a minor interaction issue where clicking a locked tab provides no feedback (19:29).

issues.description: Unrendered LaTeX code `\lambda \approx \dfrac{1.00\text{ nm}}{...}` is visible in the Wavelength box.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\lambda / d` appears multiple times in the Checkpoint section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\Delta y \approx \dfrac{\lambda L}{d}` and other formulas appear in the Fringe spacing section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\Delta y`, `\lambda`, and `d \times 2 \rightarrow \lambda \times ...` appear in the 'Change d' section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\lambda / d`, `L`, and `\Delta y` appear in the 'The transfer at a glance' section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\tan \theta` and `\Delta y / w` appear in the 'Fringe spacing vs. the detector' section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\Delta y =`, `L =`, `v =`, and `d_{max} = \frac{\lambda L}{\Delta y_{min}} =` appear in the 'Respond to the reviewer' section.
Unrendered LaTeX code for various values (e.g., `\lambda \approx 4 \times 10^{-38} m`) appears in the Error-diagnosis section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\lambda`, `d/\lambda`, `\Delta y`, and `\approx 51^\circ` appear in the 'The whole lesson at a glance' section.
Unrendered LaTeX code `\psi`, `\Delta y \approx \lambda L / d`, `d`, `\lambda`, and `\lambda = h / (mv)` appear in the Two-tier diagnostic section.
Unrendered LaTeX code for variables and formulas (e.g., `\lambda / d < 1?`, `\Delta y \approx \lambda L / d`) appears extensively in the F.O.P.S. sidebar.
The user clicks the '3 Build' tab, but there is no visible change or feedback indicating why it cannot be operated.

result.score_reason: The lesson has major rendering problems throughout, with unrendered LaTeX code appearing in dozens of places across multiple sections, making the content hard to read.
